tags.name: DocumentParserService
tags.description:
DocumentParserService converts raw/unstructured documents into a normalized
tabular representation, then optionally exports that representation to
CSV, XLSX or a Power BI push dataset.

Intended workflow:

  Raw document --> ParseDocument --> ParsedDocument
                                       |
                +----------------------+----------------------+
                |                      |                      |
                v                      v                      v
          ExportCSV (bytes)     ExportXLSX (bytes)    PublishToPowerBI

Every endpoint is independently usable. Export* and PublishToPowerBI accept
either a raw DocumentInput (parsed inline) or a ParsedDocument returned by a
previous ParseDocument call, so clients can parse once and fan out to many
destinations without re-parsing.

post.summary: ExportCSV renders the source document as UTF-8 CSV bytes.
post.description:
Errors:
  - INVALID_ARGUMENT: missing source, or a ParsedDocument whose rows do
    not align with its columns.
  - FAILED_PRECONDITION: inline raw document cannot be parsed.
  - INTERNAL: CSV serialisation failure.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: ExportCSVRequest selects the data to export. Exactly one source must be set.

post.summary:
ExportXLSX renders the source document as a real .xlsx workbook.
Numbers are written as numeric cells, booleans as booleans and datetimes
as date-formatted cells.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: ExportXLSXRequest selects the data to export. Exactly one source must be set.

post.summary:
ExtractDocument ingests any supported input (image, PDF, spreadsheet or
tabular text) through one pipeline and returns the common Document: one or
more pages carrying text, typed tables, image metadata and extracted
fields. Per-page failures are reported on each page rather than failing the
whole request.
post.description:
Validation:
  - request.document is required and document.content must be non-empty and
    within the configured size limit.
  - document.format may be DOCUMENT_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED to auto-detect.

Errors:
  - INVALID_ARGUMENT: missing/empty document or oversized content.
  - FAILED_PRECONDITION: content cannot be decoded as the detected format.

post.summary:
ParseDocument converts a raw tabular document (delimited text, markdown
table or JSON array) into a normalized ParsedDocument. For images, PDFs and
spreadsheets use ExtractDocument.
post.description:
Validation:
  - request.document is required.
  - document.content must be non-empty.
  - document.format may be DOCUMENT_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED to auto-detect.

Errors:
  - INVALID_ARGUMENT: missing/empty document, or content that does not
    match the declared (or detected) format.
  - FAILED_PRECONDITION: content is not recognisable as a supported format.

post.summary: PublishToPowerBI publishes the source document to a Power BI push dataset.
post.description:
Flow: resolve source --> map schema --> find-or-create dataset -->
clear existing rows --> push rows in batches --> return identifiers.

Validation:
  - request.dataset_name is required.
  - request.table_name defaults to "Table1" when empty.
  - request.workspace_id overrides the server-configured default; when
    both are empty the caller's "myorg" scope is used.

Errors:
  - INVALID_ARGUMENT: missing source or dataset_name.
  - FAILED_PRECONDITION: Power BI credentials are not configured.
  - UNAUTHENTICATED: token acquisition failed.
  - PERMISSION_DENIED: the service principal lacks dataset rights.
  - UNAVAILABLE: the Power BI REST API is unreachable or throttling.
  - INTERNAL: any other failure.

v1Column.description: Column describes one normalized output column.

v1ColumnType.description: ColumnType is the normalized logical type of a column.

v1DataSource.description:
DataSource lets export/publish endpoints consume either a raw document
(parsed inline) or an already-parsed ParsedDocument. Exactly one field must
be set.

format.description: Format actually used (populated on auto-detect too).

warnings.description: Document-level warnings not tied to a single page.

v1Document.description:
Document is the common, source-of-truth representation produced for every
supported input, independent of the original format.

v1DocumentFormat.description:
DocumentFormat identifies the shape of raw document content.

 - DOCUMENT_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED: Let the server detect the format from the content.
 - DOCUMENT_FORMAT_MARKDOWN_TABLE: Markdown pipe tables ("| a | b |\n|---|---|\n| 1 | 2 |").
 - DOCUMENT_FORMAT_CSV: Delimited text (comma, tab or semicolon; dialect auto-detected).
 - DOCUMENT_FORMAT_JSON: A JSON array of objects; the union of object keys becomes the columns.
 - DOCUMENT_FORMAT_PNG: PNG image.
 - DOCUMENT_FORMAT_JPEG: JPEG image.
 - DOCUMENT_FORMAT_WEBP: WebP image.
 - DOCUMENT_FORMAT_TIFF: TIFF image.
 - DOCUMENT_FORMAT_PDF: PDF document (text and/or scanned pages).
 - DOCUMENT_FORMAT_XLSX: XLSX spreadsheet workbook.
 - DOCUMENT_FORMAT_GIF: GIF image.
 - DOCUMENT_FORMAT_BMP: BMP image.

content.description: Raw bytes of the document. Required, non-empty.

name.description:
Optional human-readable name, propagated to the parsed result and used as
the basis for generated file names.

v1DocumentInput.description: DocumentInput is a raw, unparsed document.

detectedFormat.description: Format that was actually used to parse (populated on auto-detect too).

v1DocumentMetadata.description: DocumentMetadata carries derived facts about a parsed document.

v1ExportCSVRequest.description: ExportCSVRequest selects the data to export. Exactly one source must be set.

v1ExportXLSXRequest.description: ExportXLSXRequest selects the data to export. Exactly one source must be set.

content.description: Serialized file bytes (UTF-8 CSV or .xlsx workbook).

rowCount.description: Number of data rows written (excluding the header).

v1ExportedFile.description: ExportedFile is a serialized export payload.

maxPages.description: Cap on pages/sheets processed; 0 uses the server default.

v1Field.description: Field is one extracted key/value pair (e.g. an OCR form field).

v1ImageInfo.description: ImageInfo records decoded image metadata (no pixel data).

source.description: Human label: "page-3", a sheet name or an image name.

text.description: Extracted or native text, if any.

tables.description: Typed tables extracted from this page (spreadsheet sheet, PDF table, ...).

error.description: Set when this page failed; unset on success.

v1Page.description:
Page is one unit of a document: a PDF page, a spreadsheet sheet or an image.
A page that failed to process carries a non-empty error; sibling pages are
unaffected.

v1PageError.description:
PageError is a structured, per-page failure. Code is stable and
machine-readable (e.g. "DECODE_FAILED", "OCR_UNAVAILABLE"); message never
contains document bytes.

v1PageKind.description:
PageKind describes what a page primarily carries.

 - PAGE_KIND_TEXT: Native or OCR text (PDF text layer, delimited/markdown/JSON).
 - PAGE_KIND_IMAGE: A raster image, extracted via OCR when enabled.
 - PAGE_KIND_SHEET: A spreadsheet sheet.

row.description: 0-based location of the offending cell; -1 when not applicable.

v1ParseWarning.description: ParseWarning describes a non-fatal issue encountered while parsing.

v1ParsedDocument.description:
ParsedDocument is the normalized, source-of-truth representation produced by
the parser and consumed by every exporter/destination.

workspaceId.description:
Optional override of the server-configured workspace (group) id.
Empty + unconfigured server default => publish to "My workspace".

datasetName.description:
Required. Dataset display name; reused if a dataset with this name
already exists in the workspace.

v1Row.description:
Row is a positional record; values[i] corresponds to columns[i].
Rows shorter than the column list are treated as right-padded with nulls.

v1Value.description: Value is a single typed cell. An unset kind represents null/absent.
